## Evidence and receipt

Save everything to `.prove-it/runs/<UTC timestamp>-<slug>/`. Write `receipt.md` there:

```
# Receipt: <what was proved>
Verdict: PROVED | BROKEN | BLOCKED
Instance: <url or binary, version, port>
## Steps
1. <what you did to the running app> -> <what it showed> (<evidence file or inline output>)
## Probes
- <probe> -> <result>
## Not covered
- <item> -> <why> -> <the unlock that would cover it, or exact steps for a human>
## Left behind
- <test data from this run still present, or "none">
```

PROVED only if every step passed and every promised behaviour has a step you ran and watched. Reading code doesn't count. Ambiguous output is BROKEN with the raw capture attached.

- **A step counts only if its evidence shows a change you can name.** A step that changes state needs evidence from before and after (screenshot, page text, count, output). If they're identical, the step did nothing: BROKEN.
- **Check the evidence shows the target** before you cite it. A modal or banner can cover the page, and a background tab can render blank. Clear it and capture again.
- **A broken verifier is BLOCKED, never a pass.** A crash, missing file, empty output, auth error or path error means BLOCKED with the raw error attached. Never "nothing found, all fine". A missing key or service is BLOCKED too: never stub around it and report green.
- **Say when a check got weaker.** If it fell back to a lesser version (a free item instead of a paid one, stored state instead of the live flow, one browser when another is the risk), write that under Not covered.

## Limits

Keep only the lines that apply to <app>:

- Target: <the only instance, account or tenant to drive; any that are forbidden>. If a login is missing or expired, stop and report BLOCKED. Never type or ask for a password.
- Everything a run creates (records, files, test users) is named with the prefix `<zz-prove-it->` so it can be found and removed. Before starting, look for leftovers with that prefix and report them; don't silently reuse or delete them.
- Never: <buy, upgrade, send, publish or charge actions in this app>. Stop at payment and third-party consent screens.
- Secrets come from <where this repo keeps them>. Never write a secret value into this skill or features.md.

## Clean up

`<scripts/stop.sh>`: stops only what this run started (by pid file, never by process name) and removes temp data. Evidence in `.prove-it/runs/` stays.
